states.Fresh: DEX price within driftBps of the reference, reference not older than maxReferenceAgeSec, pool passes the guards.
states.Stale: Reference older than maxReferenceAgeSec (frozen feed: off-hours, weekend, holiday or corporate-action pause). Comparison is not reliable.
states.Drifting: DEX price between driftBps and brokenBps away from the reference.
states.Broken: DEX price beyond brokenBps, spot disagrees with TWAP or another deep pool beyond the allowed bps, or the multiplier changed between readings.
